summary: On-brief American-football game film: the Alligators Brno (black/orange) vs a white/green opponent on a grass pitch, shot from a single sideline camera at 640x480 on a grey autumn afternoon that dims to dusk. It IS real football — run plays, blocking, tackles at the line, sideline team rows and a goalpost establishing — so it fits a recruiting trailer, but honestly the source is limited: low resolution, mostly mid-to-far framing, flat overcast light, spectators/umbrellas in frame, and a back third that goes dark and low-energy (a post-game walk-off). The standout is a ~90-102s open-field run by ball-carrier #45 with lead blockers — the one genuinely explosive, hero-grade beat. Best used tightly cut: lift the run, the line-collisions, the sideline unity and the one sunnier action patch; punch in to hide the resolution and consider speed ramps. Drop the rainy dead-time and the dusk walk-off.
